categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor specialized equipment. Its product portfolio includes semiconductor cleaning equipment, electroplating equipment, vertical furnace tube series, front-end coating and developing track equipment, plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD) equipment, stress-free polishing equipment, advanced packaging wet process equipment, and silicon material substrate manufacturing process equipment. It also provides after-sales services and technical support through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies such as SAPS and TEBO megasonic cleaning technologies, which ensure uniform energy distribution and non-damaging cleaning of wafers. It also innovates in multi-anode localized electroplating technology for copper interconnects, stress-free polishing technology combining electrochemical polishing with CMP, and advanced wet process equipment for semiconductor packaging. The manufacturing process involves customized design and production based on customer orders, with strict supply chain and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading semiconductor manufacturers such as Yangtze Memory Technologies, Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC), Hefei Changxin, SK Hynix, Huahong Group, and Tongfu Microelectronics. The company serves the integrated circuit manufacturing industry, including logic chips, DRAM, 3D NAND, advanced packaging, and compound semiconductors. The end markets span consumer electronics, 5G communications, automotive electronics, artificial intelligence, and other high-tech sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, including Shanghai and Wuxi, with subsidiaries and R&D centers in Hong Kong, South Korea, and the United States (California). Its sales and service footprint covers mainland China, Taiwan, South Korea, and the United States, targeting global semiconductor manufacturing hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a semiconductor equipment manufacturer. It designs and assembles complex semiconductor manufacturing equipment and procures key components from suppliers, managing a comprehensive supply chain to ensure timely delivery and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes original innovation and differentiation with a focus on developing advanced semiconductor cleaning, electroplating, and packaging equipment. R&D priorities include expanding product lines to support smaller technology nodes (28nm and below), 3D NAND, DRAM, and compound semiconductors. It invests heavily in R&D (about 17% of revenue), maintains a large international R&D team, and pursues global patent protection. Future plans include enhancing product performance, expanding international markets, and pursuing strategic acquisitions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized semiconductor manufacturing equipment and related spare parts. The company follows a direct sales model without distributors, securing orders via direct negotiation, agency promotion, and bidding. Revenue recognition occurs upon customer acceptance and product delivery, including after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor equipment market is dominated by international giants such as Applied Materials, ASML, LAM Research, Tokyo Electron, and DNS. The company is among the top five semiconductor equipment manufacturers in China and holds a 7.2% global market share in single-wafer cleaning equipment. It competes by leveraging proprietary technologies like SAPS and TEBO and focuses on the Chinese mainland market while expanding internationally. Domestic competitors include North Huachuang, Chipown, and Zhichun Technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 3.89 billion, a 35.34% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 910.5 million, up 36.21%. Total assets reached RMB 9.75 billion, growing 19.3%, with net assets of RMB 6.46 billion, up 16.91%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding sales orders, new customer acquisitions, and product recognition. R&D investment increased by 53.95% to RMB 658 million, representing 16.93% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary, internationally recognized core technologies such as SAPS and TEBO megasonic cleaning, which solve global challenges in wafer cleaning uniformity and damage prevention. Its multi-anode localized electroplating and stress-free polishing technologies enhance product yield and reduce costs. The integration of slot and single-wafer cleaning in Tahoe equipment reduces chemical usage and environmental impact. The company offers customized, high-performance, low-consumption process solutions that improve production efficiency and product yield for semiconductor manufacturers.
